name: create-block/fluent-forms
title: Fluent Forms styling (internal — not a real block)
description: Not a registered block. Exists only so the build pipeline compiles the site-wide Fluent Forms styling (hand-drawn inputs, textareas and checkboxes) that used to be pasted into each form's custom CSS/JS. Enqueued directly by my-custom-block.php (mcb_enqueue_fluent_forms_styling).
